en.title: Department of Transportation: 27 references to former U.S. Code sections or former act names (46 CFR)
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Department of Transportation in 46 CFR, 27 references in 26 sections use a former address or name: 24 cite a section replaced by a new one when the title was enacted as positive law; 2 cite a former appendix not carried in the current Code; 1 cites a section transferred to another section. Each reference was compared with release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code, which names where the old number went.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references finds a note that the section moved, or no section, instead of the text. A reference to a moved section may keep its legal effect, but the address no longer leads to the text. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides how to update each reference. Where the U.S. Code names the section the old number moved to, the evidence below gives it.
